top_findings.title: Standings groups by raw team name, not the normalized team-key used everywhere else
top_findings.evidence: src/brazilian_soccer_mcp/core.clj:114 keys the standings table on raw (:home m)/(:away m) while match?/record-for/team-stats use normalized :home-key/:away-key; core_test.clj:21 bakes in the Flamengo split; _factual.json 2019 Serie A returned 21 rows / 3 Atletico rows (Athletico Paranaense split 27+11), factual_accuracy=0.5.
top_findings.suggestion: Key standings on (team-key team) like the rest of the code, carrying a display name separately, so state-suffix and accent variants collapse to one row per club.
